_comment: Accepted findings of ci.yml's advisory security-scan job (#2570), keyed tool:check:file (no line number). Each value is the reason the finding is safe. A new finding gets a ::warning; an entry that matches nothing is listed so it can be removed. Re-bless with: node scripts/security-scan-report.mjs <electronegativity.csv> <semgrep.json> --update (keeps existing reasons).

accepted.electronegativity:CSP_GLOBAL_CHECK:main/: The CSP is built by buildCsp() and set as a response header, so the static check can't parse it ('may not be valid'). Its contents are pinned by tests/main/security-helpers.test.ts.
accepted.electronegativity:OPEN_EXTERNAL_JS_CHECK: Renderer side: api.shell.openExternal goes to SHELL_OPEN_EXTERNAL, which refuses anything but http(s) in main (register-shell.ts).
Renderer side: same SHELL_OPEN_EXTERNAL http(s)-only gate in main.
Renderer side: same SHELL_OPEN_EXTERNAL http(s)-only gate in main.
Opens hardcoded https constants (DOCS_URL and the issues URL), never input.
Only after externalNavTarget() classified the URL as http(s) (tests/main/security-helpers.test.ts).
Parsed with new URL() and refused unless the protocol is http: or https:.
Refuses (throws on) any non-http(s) authorization URL before opening it.
accepted.electronegativity:AUXCLICK_JS_CHECK:main: A middle-click new window goes through setWindowOpenHandler, and #2559's deny-by-default web-contents-created guard denies it.
A middle-click new window goes through the main window's setWindowOpenHandler (security.ts), which opens http(s) externally and denies the rest.
Hidden, never-shown print window over our own exported HTML; no user input reaches it, and #2559's guard denies window opens.
accepted.electronegativity:CONTEXT_ISOLATION_JS_C: False positive: contextIsolation:true comes from ...HARDENED_WEB_PREFERENCES, which the static check can't follow.
accepted.electronegativity:PRELOAD_JS_CHECK:main/: The main window's preload is the contextBridge API by design. Its whole surface is snapshotted (preload-bridge.test.ts), and every handler checks its sender (#2553).
